title: Accidental Death Rider Rate in Effect on a Back Installment's Due Date — Term Life Insurance
content:
**Term Life Insurance — accidental death rider rate for back installments billed for reinstatement.** The rate per 1,000 of rider amount is the one in effect on the installment's due date, set by the insured's age for that due date: the whole years from the insured's date of birth to the most recent policy anniversary on or before the due date.

| Insured's age for the due date | Rate in effect per 1,000 |
|---|---|
| the product's accidental death rider expiry age (70 on every tier) or more | nothing — the rider ended on that anniversary |
| 60 through 69 | 1.08 |
| below 45 | 0.84 |
| 45 through 59 | the product's accidental death rider rate per 1,000 |

**Cases (hypothetical).**

- Policy anniversary 1 July; insured aged 69 at the anniversary of 1 July 2025 and 70 at that of 1 July 2026. A back installment due 1 April 2026 takes 1.08; one due 1 October 2026 takes nothing.
- Insured aged 44 at the most recent anniversary before the due date: 0.84.
- Insured aged 52: the product's rate.

The age is taken at the anniversary on or before the due date of the installment being billed, not at today's date.
